hints.title: Multiply Odd Numbers Once
hints.text: Pre-multiply all odd numbers by 2 so every number is at its maximum possible value.

hints.title: Max-Heap Extraction
hints.text: Track the maximum element in a max-heap and maintain the minimum element across all values.

hints.title: Divide Even Maximum
hints.text: Halve the current maximum and reinsert while it remains even, terminating when the maximum is odd.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def minimumDeviation(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        pq = []
        min_val = float("inf")
        for x in nums:
            if x % 2 == 1:
                x *= 2
            pq.append(-x)
            min_val = min(min_val, x)
        heapq.heapify(pq)
        min_dev = float("inf")
        while True:
            max_val = -heapq.heappop(pq)
            min_dev = min(min_dev, max_val - min_val)
            if max_val % 2 == 1:
                break
            half = max_val // 2
            min_val = min(min_val, half)
            heapq.heappush(pq, -half)
        return min_dev
```

variables: max_val is maximum value in nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Allowing bidirectional changes (multiply odd, divide even) produces an unbounded search graph.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-multiplying odd numbers converts the problem into a one-directional halving simulation using a heap.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate eliminates odd-multiplication asymmetry by doubling odds upfront and halving evens iteratively.

solutions.approach: Max-heap with initial odd doubling and iterative halving
